mission: Push Galaxy Sports Edge toward best overall website of 2026: a trust-first, intelligence-rich, emotionally aware decision system that does not feel like a sportsbook, SaaS dashboard, media site, or AI slop.

productStandards.name: Worldview
productStandards.definition: Every surface must express Galaxy as restraint, transparent reasoning, and decision intelligence rather than betting hype.

productStandards.name: Living Data
productStandards.definition: Freshness, source context, demo/live/historical/user-entered state, and stale/degraded behavior must be visible.

productStandards.name: Signature Interactions
productStandards.definition: Core interactions should feel ownable by Galaxy, not generic cards, dashboards, or sportsbook patterns.

productStandards.name: Introspection as Content
productStandards.definition: Losses, passes, what changed, what to ignore, and what could be wrong are product content, not footnotes.

productStandards.name: Continuous Voice
productStandards.definition: Copy must remain disciplined across public, demo, member, empty, error, and degraded states.

productStandards.name: Narrative Arc
productStandards.definition: A user should move from chaos to clarity to restraint or action to learning without dead ends.

productStandards.name: Performance as Design
productStandards.definition: Speed, mobile readability, accessible focus, stable layout, and low cognitive load are part of the brand.

hardConstraints: Do not move confidential methodology client-side
Do not use certainty, tout, casino, or loss-chasing language

agentRoles.Codex: Truth, audit, release safety, safe patches, verdicts, owner firewall, validation, and autonomous requeueing.
agentRoles.Claude: Ambitious product integration, missing surfaces, premium UX, signature interactions, runtime states, and builder repairs.
agentRoles.Repo: Source of truth; if not committed and pushed, it does not coordinate future agents.

verdictRules.safeToContinueBuilding: yes unless safety blocks further work
verdictRules.safeToMerge: no until state is clean, validation is green, gap matrix has no merge blockers, and owner approves merge policy
verdictRules.safeToDeployPreview: no until local release gates and owner preview inputs are ready
verdictRules.safeToPublicLaunch: no until preview, owner, data, privacy, rollback, monitoring, and public/private boundary evidence all pass
verdictRules.safeToEnablePayments: no until owner approval, Stripe readiness, webhook tests, entitlement tests, and rollback pass
verdictRules.safeToEnableLiveAI: no until owner approval and live AI readiness gates pass
verdictRules.safeToEnablePublicPicks: no until owner approval, data freshness, canonical history, and public trust gates pass

supersessionRule: This operating plan supersedes earlier conflicting local release-control instructions. Earlier docs remain evidence/reference unless explicitly marked ACTIVE or MERGED in PLAN_ALIGNMENT_AUDIT.md.
